payload.text: Hand run on hv's machine, recorded as such, from the dev build at the landed SHA under ~/.local/state (a bundle under /private/tmp is refused by the notification centre, D13): the launch logs 'notifications: granted', the first request under the bundle id being macOS 27's alert, answered Allow by hv, or the id allowed under System Settings > Notifications > menuz (until then the launch logs that macOS is asking and the runs' notices read not yet allowed, and that first attempt's transcript is kept beside the passing one); a run that exits non-zero while the app runs and one that ends after the app quit each land 'notice posted' in the log under their ids; the first-launch line is logged at launch when the position key is absent and posted once granted; the status item shows the mark with no icon: line.
